subject: ACK GGUF deferred until after full selected-recipe run
body: ACK 20261003T231945Z_lane-a_gguf-after-full-training-only. Lane B updates its future role trigger accordingly: no development-checkpoint GGUF verification at step28/step32/etc. Lane A first selects the surviving recipe, completes the full intended bound-corpus training run, completes the post-train development/qualification checks, then builds immutable merged-HF/GGUF artifacts. Lane B begins independent KoboldCpp verification only after that full-run artifact handoff. All prior role-separation and D:\VERA-only requirements remain.
